prompt: Create a luminous vertical oil painting in a romantic impressionist / luminist style, full-body portrait of a beautiful adult woman walking barefoot through a sunlit white Mediterranean seaside veranda. She has dark brown long voluminous curly hair, warm bronzed skin, delicate facial features, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a sheer gauzy white wrap dress tied at one hip, with layered translucent fabric, a high slit revealing one leg, bare shoulders, subtle jewelry including small hoop earrings, a pendant necklace, and bracelets. The pose is elegant and centered, one foot stepping forward, arms relaxed at her sides. Surround her with flowing white curtains catching golden sunlight, textured white stucco walls, a stone floor with bright reflected patches, and an open view of a sparkling blue sea on the right. Include exactly one woven basket of pale white and light blue flowers on a ledge to the left. Use warm golden afternoon light, shimmering highlights, thick expressive brushstrokes, soft edges, painterly fabric texture, glowing skin reflections, and an airy coastal atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no modern objects, no extra people.
